title: 细分图中的可到达节点
summary: 每条原边被插入 cnt 个新节点，从节点零出发最多走 maxMoves 步，求可到达的原节点和新节点总数。
insight: 先在原节点图上用边权 cnt+1 求最短路；一条边从两端最多分别进入 maxMoves-distance 级，边上可达新节点数是两端余步之和与 cnt 的较小值。
pitfalls: 原边权是新增节点数加一
不可达端的剩余步数按零
每个细分节点在对应边只计一次

solutions.title: 原图最短路与边内余步
solutions.idea: 分别统计可达原节点和每条边可覆盖的新节点。
steps: 建邻接表边权 count+1，从零 Dijkstra 得 distance
distance<=maxMoves 的原节点各贡献一
对每条 [u,v,count]，fromU=max(0,maxMoves-distance[u])，fromV 对称，贡献 min(count,fromU+fromV)

code.java: class Solution { public int reachableNodes(int[][] edges,int maxMoves,int n){List<int[]>[] graph=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(new int[]{edge[1],edge[2]+1});graph[edge[1]].add(new int[]{edge[0],edge[2]+1});}long[] distance=new long[n];Arrays.fill(distance,Long.MAX_VALUE);distance[0]=0;PriorityQueue<long[]> heap=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a->a[0]));heap.offer(new long[]{0,0});while(!heap.isEmpty()){long[] state=heap.poll();int node=(int)state[1];if(state[0]!=distance[node])continue;for(int[] edge:graph[node]){long next=state[0]+edge[1];if(next<distance[edge[0]]){distance[edge[0]]=next;heap.offer(new long[]{next,edge[0]});}}}long answer=0;for(long value:distance)if(value<=maxMoves)answer++;for(int[] edge:edges){long fromU=distance[edge[0]]<=maxMoves?maxMoves-distance[edge[0]]:0,fromV=distance[edge[1]]<=maxMoves?maxMoves-distance[edge[1]]:0;answer+=Math.min((long)edge[2],fromU+fromV);}return(int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun reachableNodes(edges:Array<IntArray>,maxMoves:Int,n:Int):Int{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<IntArray>()};for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(intArrayOf(edge[1],edge[2]+1));graph[edge[1]].add(intArrayOf(edge[0],edge[2]+1))};val distance=LongArray(n){Long.MAX_VALUE};distance[0]=0;val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<LongArray>(compareBy{it[0]});heap.add(longArrayOf(0,0));while(heap.isNotEmpty()){val state=heap.remove();val node=state[1].toInt();if(state[0]!=distance[node])continue;for(edge in graph[node]){val next=state[0]+edge[1];if(next<distance[edge[0]]){distance[edge[0]]=next;heap.add(longArrayOf(next,edge[0].toLong()))}}};var answer=distance.count{it<=maxMoves}.toLong();for(edge in edges){val fromU=if(distance[edge[0]]<=maxMoves)maxMoves-distance[edge[0]] else 0;val fromV=if(distance[edge[1]]<=maxMoves)maxMoves-distance[edge[1]] else 0;answer+=minOf(edge[2].toLong(),fromU+fromV)};return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int reachableNodes(vector<vector<int>>& edges,int maxMoves,int n){vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> graph(n);for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back({edge[1],edge[2]+1});graph[edge[1]].push_back({edge[0],edge[2]+1});}vector<long long> distance(n,LLONG_MAX);priority_queue<pair<long long,int>,vector<pair<long long,int>>,greater<pair<long long,int>>> heap;distance[0]=0;heap.push({0,0});while(!heap.empty()){auto [current,node]=heap.top();heap.pop();if(current!=distance[node])continue;for(auto [next,weight]:graph[node])if(current+weight<distance[next]){distance[next]=current+weight;heap.push({distance[next],next});}}long long answer=0;for(long long value:distance)answer+=value<=maxMoves;for(auto& edge:edges){long long fromU=distance[edge[0]]<=maxMoves?maxMoves-distance[edge[0]]:0,fromV=distance[edge[1]]<=maxMoves?maxMoves-distance[edge[1]]:0;answer+=min((long long)edge[2],fromU+fromV);}return answer;} };
